messages:
emma: Heads-up — courier left a guitar case and a small transit envelope in the lobby for our 4:15 visitor (Theo M.). Front desk says visitor sticker roll snapped while printing. Anyone available to do a handwritten badge + escort? :guitar:
frontdesk: delivery note — items on left bench. visitor-stickers = 0, spare blank badge cards in supply closet. kiosk is offline, handwritten ok.
lucas: I can run down in 6 and make a handwritten sticker. Also can move the guitar to Locker-4 if needed. Which locker code?
emma: please use Locker-4. code:
1238
Also add a sticky: "Theo M. - 4:15" and tape the envelope to the case. If Theo needs a seat, window desk A2 should be free.
riley: I'll flag window desk A2 and meet Theo at reception. Lucas — huge thanks. :coffee:
frontdesk: sticker applied by hand and taped to lanyard. guitar placed in Locker-4 with sticky note. kiosk ticket opened for sticker rolls.
emma: perfect — thanks everyone. If courier calls use code 1238 and ask for ID. (reaction: :white_check_mark:)
file_notes: watercooler: visitor guitar case delivery, broken sticker roll, handwritten badge, locker code, window seat reserved
